intended_object: The functorial map A/cl(A^n) → B/cl(B^n) between quotients of abelian topological groups by the closure of the subgroup of n-th powers, induced by a continuous homomorphism f : A → B (from the docstring and name).
explanation: `closedPowers A n` is the topological closure of the subgroup of n-th powers, and `TopologicalPowerQuotient A n` is A modulo that subgroup. The map lifts mk ∘ f through the quotient. This is well defined because f sends cl(A^n) into cl(B^n), which the lemma `map_closedPowers_le` proves from the continuity of f. Continuity of the lifted map follows from the universal property of the quotient map. On classes the map sends [a] to [f a], which is the standard induced map. The setting is commutative topological groups. Commutativity is needed so that the n-th powers form a (normal) subgroup, so the generality is the natural one. Mathlib has `QuotientGroup.map`, but no bundled continuous version for this specific quotient, so there is no exact counterpart.
